seats.findings: 🟠 [coupon-divisor] MUST-FIX src/coupon.js:5 divides by 1000 instead of 100, so the discount is one tenth of the specified Math.round(subtotal * p / 100); this makes checkoutTotal (src/checkout.js:7) overcharge, e.g. checkoutTotal(10000, 10, 0, 0) returns 9900 instead of 9000; change the divisor to 100

🟠 [coupon-divisor-1000] MUST-FIX src/coupon.js:5 divides by 1000 instead of 100 (`Math.round((subtotal * p) / 1000)`), contradicting both the function's own comment and the checkoutTotal contract, so every discount is 10x too small (e.g. subtotal=20000, pct=10 → 200 cents instead of 2000) and src/checkout.js:7 (checkoutTotal) returns a taxable amount and total that exceed the spec by roughly the missing discount plus its tax; smallest remediation is changing the divisor to 100 in src/coupon.js:5, after which checkoutTotal matches its contract (coupon clamp 0..100, tax, and shipping are otherwise correct)

🟠 [coupon-divisor] MUST-FIX src/coupon.js:5 divides by 1000 instead of 100 (`Math.round((subtotal * p) / 1000)`); the spec and the function's own comment both require `Math.round(subtotal * pct / 100)`, so every discount computed by couponCents (and transitively checkoutTotal) is 10× too small, causing overcharges; change the divisor to 100
